response.overview: Separated in childhood, a brother and sister reunite on a TV show that gives them a picture-perfect ending on screen. Off-camera, they set out on their first trip together, hoping to carry that closeness into real life. But when the cameras stop, they must face a harder reality: how do you build a real relationship with someone who should feel like family, but is a stranger? As they travel side by side, they long for a deeper connection to make up for the years they lost. But building a relationship without shared memories brings unexpected tension, forcing them to confront what they are to each other and whether they can truly bridge the distance between.
response.title: Family Album
